functions.name: Formula
functions.done: Returns the object when it already inherits Formula, otherwise splits a formula on top-level | into lhs and rhs attributes on the original call.

check.case: Two-part and multi-part formulas, one-sided formulas, identity on an existing Formula, and errors for non-formulas

proof.r:
.libPaths(c("/home/ahmed/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.5", .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Formula))
stopifnot(identical(packageDescription("Formula")$Version, "1.2-6"))

f1 <- y ~ x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3
f2 <- y1 | y2 + y3 ~ x1 + I(x2^2) | 0 + log(x1) | x3 / x4
f3 <- ~ x + y
f4 <- y1 | y2 ~ x
f5 <- y ~ a | b | c
f6 <- y1 + y2 | y3 ~ x
f7 <- y ~ x

F1 <- Formula(f1)
F2 <- Formula(f2)

line <- function(expr) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      val <- eval(expr, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      if (inherits(val, "Formula")) {
        cls <- paste(class(val), collapse = ",")
        fl <- length(unclass(val))
        body <- paste(deparse(val), collapse = " ")
        al <- attr(val, "lhs")
        ar <- attr(val, "rhs")
        lhs_len <- if (is.null(al)) -1L else length(al)
        rhs_len <- if (is.null(ar)) -1L else length(ar)
        dep <- function(x) paste(deparse(x), collapse = " ")
        lhs_parts <- if (is.null(al)) "" else paste(vapply(al, dep, character(1)), collapse = ";")
        rhs_parts <- if (is.null(ar)) "" else paste(vapply(ar, dep, character(1)), collapse = ";")
        ll <- if (inherits(val, "Formula")) paste(c(length(attr(val, "lhs")), length(attr(val, "rhs"))), collapse = ",") else "-1,-1"
        paste(cls, fl, body, lhs_len, rhs_len, lhs_parts, rhs_parts, ll, sep = "|")
      } else {
        paste("OTHER", deparse(val), sep = "|")
      }
    },
    error = function(e) paste0("ERR ", conditionMessage(e))
  )
}

one <- function() {
  exprs <- list(
    quote(Formula(f1)),
    quote(Formula(f2)),
    quote(Formula(f3)),
    quote(Formula(f4)),
    quote(Formula(f5)),
    quote(Formula(f6)),
    quote(Formula(f7)),
    quote(Formula(F1)),
    quote(Formula(1)),
    quote(Formula("y ~ x"))
  )
  id <- if (identical(Formula(F1), F1)) "TRUE" else "FALSE"
  paste(c(vapply(exprs, line, character(1)), paste0("ID ", id)), collapse = " || ")
}

value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (step_i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[step_i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat("VALUE ", value, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from Formula.formula import Formula, as_r_formula, fingerprint
from Formula.is_formula import FormulaError

f1 = as_r_formula("y ~ x1 + x2 | z1 + z2 + z3")
f2 = as_r_formula("y1 | y2 + y3 ~ x1 + I(x2^2) | 0 + log(x1) | x3 / x4")
f3 = as_r_formula("~ x + y")
f4 = as_r_formula("y1 | y2 ~ x")
f5 = as_r_formula("y ~ a | b | c")
f6 = as_r_formula("y1 + y2 | y3 ~ x")
f7 = as_r_formula("y ~ x")

F1 = Formula(f1)


def line(fn):
    try:
        val = fn()
    except FormulaError as exc:
        return "ERR " + str(exc)
    if hasattr(val, "classes"):
        return fingerprint(val)
    return "OTHER|" + str(val)


def one():
    calls = [
        lambda: Formula(f1),
        lambda: Formula(f2),
        lambda: Formula(f3),
        lambda: Formula(f4),
        lambda: Formula(f5),
        lambda: Formula(f6),
        lambda: Formula(f7),
        lambda: Formula(F1),
        lambda: Formula(1),
        lambda: Formula("y ~ x"),
    ]
    parts = [line(fn) for fn in calls]
    ident = "TRUE" if Formula(F1) is F1 else "FALSE"
    parts.append("ID " + ident)
    return " || ".join(parts)


def identical(a, b):
    return a is b


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print("VALUE " + value)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")

functions.name: is.Formula
functions.done: is.Formula is inherits(object, "Formula"): an S3 class matches when that name is in the class vector, and an S4 object matches from its primary class and extends chain.

check.case: Formula, plain formula, NULL, atomics, S3 class vectors including a missing name, an S4 subclass, an unregistered S4 class, and argument-match errors

.libPaths(c("/home/ahmed/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.5", .libPaths()))

setClass("Formula", contains = "numeric")
setClass("ChildF", contains = "Formula")
setClass("Other", contains = "numeric")

import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from Formula.is_formula import FormulaError, RClassed, is_Formula

CHILD = ("ChildF", "Formula", "numeric", "vector")
FORMULA_EXT = ("Formula", "numeric", "vector")
OTHER = ("Other", "numeric", "vector")

fml = RClassed(classes=("Formula", "formula"))
plain = RClassed(classes=("formula",))
s3_formula = RClassed(classes=("Formula",))
s3_lower = RClassed(classes=("formula",))
s3_second = RClassed(classes=("foo", "Formula"))
s3_first = RClassed(classes=("Formula", "formula"))
s3_child = RClassed(classes=("ChildF",), extends=CHILD)
s4_child = RClassed(classes=("ChildF",), s4=True, extends=CHILD)
s4_formula = RClassed(classes=("Formula",), s4=True, extends=FORMULA_EXT)
s4_other = RClassed(classes=("Other",), s4=True, extends=OTHER)
s4_primary = RClassed(classes=("Formula",), s4=True)
s4_second = RClassed(classes=("foo", "Formula"), s4=True)
na_s3 = RClassed(classes=(None, "Formula"))
na_s4 = RClassed(classes=(None, "Formula"), s4=True)
only_na = RClassed(classes=(None,))
form_na = RClassed(classes=("Formula", None))
form_na_s4 = RClassed(classes=("Formula", None), s4=True)
env_f = RClassed(classes=("Formula",))
bare = RClassed(classes=("call",))
spaced = RClassed(classes=("Formula ",))
empty_cl = RClassed(classes=("",))
fn_f = RClassed(classes=("Formula",))
prepended = RClassed(classes=("bar", "Formula", "formula"))
matrix_v = RClassed(classes=("matrix", "array"))
factor_v = RClassed(classes=("factor",))
asis = RClassed(classes=("AsIs",))
frame = RClassed(classes=("data.frame",))
na_logical = RClassed(classes=("logical",))
nan_v = RClassed(classes=("numeric",))


def line(fn):
    try:
        val = fn()
    except FormulaError as exc:
        return "ERR " + str(exc)
    if val is True:
        return "TRUE"
    if val is False:
        return "FALSE"
    return "OTHER"


def one():
    calls = [
        lambda: is_Formula(fml),
        lambda: is_Formula(plain),
        lambda: is_Formula(None),
        lambda: is_Formula(1),
        lambda: is_Formula(1),
        lambda: is_Formula(True),
        lambda: is_Formula("Formula"),
        lambda: is_Formula([]),
        lambda: is_Formula([]),
        lambda: is_Formula(s3_formula),
        lambda: is_Formula(s3_lower),
        lambda: is_Formula(s3_second),
        lambda: is_Formula(s3_first),
        lambda: is_Formula(s3_child),
        lambda: is_Formula(s4_child),
        lambda: is_Formula(s4_formula),
        lambda: is_Formula(s4_other),
        lambda: is_Formula(s4_primary),
        lambda: is_Formula(s4_second),
        lambda: is_Formula(na_s3),
        lambda: is_Formula(na_s4),
        lambda: is_Formula(only_na),
        lambda: is_Formula(form_na),
        lambda: is_Formula(form_na_s4),
        lambda: is_Formula(env_f),
        lambda: is_Formula(bare),
        lambda: is_Formula(spaced),
        lambda: is_Formula(empty_cl),
        lambda: is_Formula(fn_f),
        lambda: is_Formula(prepended),
        lambda: is_Formula(matrix_v),
        lambda: is_Formula(factor_v),
        lambda: is_Formula(asis),
        lambda: is_Formula(frame),
        lambda: is_Formula(na_logical),
        lambda: is_Formula(nan_v),
        lambda: is_Formula(object=None),
        lambda: is_Formula(ob=s3_formula),
        lambda: is_Formula(o=1),
        lambda: is_Formula(),
        lambda: is_Formula(1, 2),
        lambda: is_Formula(1, 2, 3),
        lambda: is_Formula(1, foo=2),
        lambda: is_Formula(1, foo=2, bar=3),
        lambda: is_Formula(object=s3_formula, o=1, ob=2),
        lambda: is_Formula(o=1, ob=2),
        lambda: is_Formula(1, o=2),
        lambda: is_Formula(Object=1),
        lambda: is_Formula(2, object=s3_formula),
    ]
    return " | ".join(line(fn) for fn in calls)


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print("VALUE " + value)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")

functions.name: model.part
functions.done: Subsets a model frame to the variables for selected Formula lhs and rhs parts, including drop on a single column.

check.case: Vignette-style lhs and rhs part extraction on model frames, drop TRUE, a plain-formula error, and invalid lhs, rhs, and data errors

import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from Formula.formula import Formula, as_r_formula
from Formula.is_formula import FormulaError
from Formula.model_part import RFrame, fingerprint_part, model_part

MF2 = RFrame(
    {
        "y1": [0.69999999999999996, 0.65000000000000002],
        "y2": ["a", "b"],
        "x3": ["b", "a"],
    },
    row_names=[2, 3],
)
MF1 = RFrame(
    {
        "log(y1)": [-0.19845093872383832, -0.35667494393873245, -0.43078291609245423],
        "x1": [0.089999999999999997, 0.26000000000000001, 0.029999999999999999],
        "x2": [0.22, 0.46000000000000002, 0.37],
        "I(x1^2)": [0.0080999999999999996, 0.067600000000000007, 0.00089999999999999998],
    },
    row_names=[1, 2, 3],
)
MF3 = RFrame(
    {
        "y1": [0.69999999999999996, 0.65000000000000002],
        "y2": ["a", "b"],
        "log(y3)": [-1.7719568419318752, -1.2729656758128873],
        "x1": [0.26000000000000001, 0.029999999999999999],
        "I(x2^2)": [0.21160000000000001, 0.13689999999999999],
        "log(x1)": [-1.3470736479666092, -3.5065578973199818],
        "x3": ["b", "a"],
        "x4": ["b", "a"],
        "(weights)": [0.26000000000000001, 0.029999999999999999],
    },
    row_names=[2, 3],
)

DAT = RFrame(
    {
        "y1": [0.81999999999999995, 0.69999999999999996, 0.65000000000000002],
        "y2": [None, "a", "b"],
        "y3": [0.27000000000000002, 0.17000000000000001, 0.28000000000000003],
        "x1": [0.089999999999999997, 0.26000000000000001, 0.029999999999999999],
        "x2": [0.22, 0.46000000000000002, 0.37],
        "x3": ["a", "b", "a"],
        "x4": ["b", "b", "a"],
    },
    row_names=[1, 2, 3],
)

F1 = Formula(as_r_formula("log(y1) ~ x1 + x2 | I(x1^2)"))
F2 = Formula(as_r_formula("y1 + y2 ~ x3"))
F3 = Formula(
    as_r_formula("y1 + y2 | log(y3) ~ x1 + I(x2^2) | 0 + log(x1) | x3 / x4")
)
def line(fn):
    try:
        val = fn()
    except FormulaError as exc:
        return "ERR " + str(exc)
    return fingerprint_part(val)


def one():
    calls = [
        lambda: model_part(F2, data=MF2, lhs=1),
        lambda: model_part(F1, data=MF1, lhs=1, drop=True),
        lambda: model_part(F3, data=MF3, lhs=1),
        lambda: model_part(F3, data=MF3, lhs=2),
        lambda: model_part(F1, data=MF1, rhs=1),
        lambda: model_part(F1, data=MF1, rhs=2),
        lambda: model_part(as_r_formula("y1 + y2 ~ x3"), data=MF2, lhs=1),
        lambda: model_part(F1, data=MF1, lhs=0, rhs=0),
        lambda: model_part(F1, data=DAT, lhs=1),
    ]
    return " || ".join(line(fn) for fn in calls)


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "model.part-py-out.txt"

    "VALUE " + value + "\n" + f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}\n",
    encoding="utf-8",
)
